scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test: node --test src/lib/delivery-acts.test.ts src/lib/legacy-driver-similarity.test.ts src/lib/reconcile-delivery-uploads.test.ts && pnpm exec esbuild src/lib/delivery-upload-cleanup.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@google-cloud/storage --external:pg-native --outfile=/tmp/delivery-upload-cleanup.test.cjs && node --test /tmp/delivery-upload-cleanup.test.cjs && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:roles-smoke: pnpm exec esbuild src/scripts/role-release-smoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@google-cloud/storage --external:pg-native --outfile=dist/role-release-smoke.cjs && node dist/role-release-smoke.cjs
scripts.cleanup:delivery-uploads: pnpm exec esbuild src/scripts/reconcile-delivery-uploads.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@google-cloud/storage --external:pg-native --outfile=dist/reconcile-delivery-uploads.cjs && node dist/reconcile-delivery-uploads.cjs
